statement: The function returns a result r. Let a collision step mean choosing an index i with 0 <= i < len(L)-1, L[i] > 0, and L[i+1] < 0 in a list L, deleting the two adjacent entries L[i], L[i+1], and inserting in their place the single entry L[i] if L[i] > -L[i+1], no entry if L[i] = -L[i+1], or the single entry L[i+1] if L[i] < -L[i+1]. Then r is the unique list reachable from asteroids by finitely many such collision steps and having no index i with 0 <= i < len(r)-1, r[i] > 0, and r[i+1] < 0. Equivalently, r is the state of the asteroids after all collisions; r may be empty.
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0.

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail by arithmetic overflow, out-of-bounds slice access, or panic.
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0.

statement: The function returns a result r and 0 <= len(r) <= len(asteroids).
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0.

statement: The function returns a result r and for every j with 0 <= j < len(r), r[j] != 0.
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0.

statement: The function returns a result r and there is a strictly increasing sequence i_0, i_1, ..., i_{len(r)-1} of indices into asteroids (empty when len(r)=0) such that 0 <= i_0 < i_1 < ... < i_{len(r)-1} < len(asteroids) and r[j] = asteroids[i_j] for every j with 0 <= j < len(r).
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0.

statement: The function returns a result r and there exists an integer k with 0 <= k <= len(r) such that for every j with 0 <= j < k, r[j] < 0, and for every j with k <= j < len(r), r[j] > 0.
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0.

statement: The function returns a result r, len(r) >= 1, and r[0] = asteroids[0].
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0; asteroids[0] < 0.

statement: The function returns a result r, len(r) >= 1, and r[len(r)-1] = asteroids[len(asteroids)-1].
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0; asteroids[len(asteroids)-1] > 0.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = asteroids.
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0; there exists k with 0 <= k <= len(asteroids) such that for every j with 0 <= j < k, asteroids[j] < 0, and for every j with k <= j < len(asteroids), asteroids[j] > 0.

statement: Let a = asteroids[0] and b = asteroids[1]. The function returns a result r, and: if a > 0 and b < 0 and a > -b, then len(r)=1 and r[0]=a; if a > 0 and b < 0 and a = -b, then len(r)=0; if a > 0 and b < 0 and a < -b, then len(r)=1 and r[0]=b; in all other cases len(r)=2, r[0]=a, and r[1]=b.
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0; len(asteroids) = 2.

statement: Let n = len(asteroids). The function returns a result r. If there is no index j with 1 <= j < n and asteroids[0] <= -asteroids[j], then len(r)=1 and r[0]=asteroids[0]. Otherwise let j be the least such index. If asteroids[0] = -asteroids[j], then len(r)=n-1-j and for every t with 0 <= t < len(r), r[t]=asteroids[j+1+t]. If asteroids[0] < -asteroids[j], then len(r)=n-j and for every t with 0 <= t < len(r), r[t]=asteroids[j+t].
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0; asteroids[0] > 0; for every i with 1 <= i < len(asteroids), asteroids[i] < 0.

statement: Let n = len(asteroids) and b = -asteroids[n-1]. The function returns a result r. If there is no index j with 0 <= j < n-1 and asteroids[j] >= b, then len(r)=1 and r[0]=asteroids[n-1]. Otherwise let j be the greatest such index. If asteroids[j] = b, then len(r)=j and for every t with 0 <= t < len(r), r[t]=asteroids[t]. If asteroids[j] > b, then len(r)=j+1 and for every t with 0 <= t < len(r), r[t]=asteroids[t].
preconditions: 2 <= len(asteroids) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids), -1000 <= asteroids[i] <= 1000 and asteroids[i] != 0; asteroids[len(asteroids)-1] < 0; for every i with 0 <= i < len(asteroids)-1, asteroids[i] > 0.
